en.headline: Doo Hoi-kem and Wu Yung-lin take women’s doubles silver at WTT Sweden Smash
en.dek: The Hong Kong pair, who earlier upset the world No. 1 Chinese duo, fell 1-3 to Japan’s Hina Hayata and Miwa Harimoto in the final of the Grand Smash event.
body: Hong Kong’s Doo Hoi-kem and Wu Yung-lin captured the women’s doubles silver medal at the WTT Sweden Smash after losing the final 1-3 to Japan’s Hina Hayata and Miwa Harimoto.

The pair had earlier eliminated the world No. 1 combination of Wang Manyu and Kuai Man in five games and then defeated South Korea’s Shin Yu-bin and Joo Qian-xi to reach their first Grand Smash final. In the decider they recovered from a 6-11 first-game deficit to take the second 11-9 before dropping the next two games 11-13 and 9-11.

The result adds to Hong Kong’s strong showing at the event, where Wong Chun-ting and Doo also collected mixed-doubles silver. The ranking points strengthen the pair’s position ahead of the Asian Games in Nagoya.

zh.headline: 杜凱琹吳詠琳瑞典大滿貫女雙摘銀 力戰不敵日本世二
zh.dek: 港隊組合先後擊敗中國世一及韓國世三晉級決賽，最終以1比3不敵日本早田希娜／張本美和，奪得大滿貫女雙亞軍。
body: 港乒女雙組合杜凱琹／吳詠琳在WTT瑞典大滿貫決賽以局數1比3不敵日本「世二」組合早田希娜／張本美和，奪得亞軍。
「杜吳配」晉級過程表現亮眼，八強五局擊敗中國隊世界排名第一的王曼昱／蒯曼，四強再以3比2淘汰韓國申裕斌／朱芊曦，首度殺入大滿貫女雙決賽。決賽首局以6比11落後，次局11比9扳平，其後兩局分別以11比13及9比11落敗。
今次亞軍為兩人合作以來首個大滿貫獎牌，亦為港隊於本站賽事再添一銀。排名積分有助兩人備戰稍後名古屋亞運。
